'''Trezza''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], and headmaster of the [[Orsis Academy]]. Over 200 years old, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] was on good terms with a disguised [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], claiming not to be a fan of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and not asking too many questions during a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul's]] enrollment, where he once saved the young boy from being shot by [[Meltch Krakko]]. The Falleen could "smell" when [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was used and could tell that Maul was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. After a failed attempt to get rid of Maul by Krakko, Maul was ordered by Sidious to eliminate everyone at the academy. Trezza tried to kill him by throwing a knife at him, but Maul caught the knife with his Force-enhanced reflexes and threw it back, killing him.
